paperBatchSetupHint: Review the papers and limits below. Nothing is sent to a model until you explicitly start.
paperBatchLimit: A batch supports at most {{max}} papers. Remove papers below; nothing is silently omitted.
paperBatchEmpty: No papers selected. Choose papers from the library or a group.
paperBatchQuestion: What should each explanation focus on?
paperBatchFiles: Conversation + a new article beside each paper
paperBatchFilesHint: Completed explanations are saved as new <paper title>-explanation-<short batch ID>.md files in the original paper directories and registered as interpretations. Existing files are never overwritten.
paperBatchCost: Up to {{count}} model requests, sequentially, one per paper. At most {{max}} source characters per request. No automatic model retries.
paperBatchPriceUnknown: The configured provider may charge for usage. A monetary estimate is unavailable; the limit above is a request limit, not a currency budget.
paperBatchLimited: Limited material; only quick screening is available. Long text is capped at 80,000 characters.
paperBatchConsent: I agree to send these frozen paper sources and my question to the shown provider/model and use the selected output destination.
paperBatchWrongLibrary: Return to the source library to start or continue this batch.
paperBatchRuntimeUnavailable: Connect to the Kun runtime before starting this batch.
paperBatchOtherBusy: Another conversation is running. You can review this batch now and start after that request finishes.
